svg.title: Pooled estimates: atrial fibrillation on GLP-1 drugs
svg.desc: Pooled estimates: atrial fibrillation on GLP-1 drugs. Semaglutide vs placebo (network meta-analysis, 2026): RR 0.82 (95% interval 0.68 to 0.99). Semaglutide vs tirzepatide (network meta-analysis, 2026): RR 0.57 (95% interval 0.37 to 0.88). Semaglutide vs placebo (10 trials, 2024): RR 0.58 (95% interval 0.4 to 0.85). GLP-1 drugs in obesity vs placebo (24 trials, 2026): RR 0.82 (95% interval 0.7 to 0.96). GLP-1 drugs in obesity vs placebo (EHJ, 2026): RR 0.79 (95% interval 0.63 to 0.99). GLP-1 heart-outcome trials in diabetes (8 trials, 2022): RR 0.96 (95% interval 0.86 to 1.07). Tirzepatide vs placebo (10 trials, 2026): OR 2.2 (95% interval 0.81 to 6.75).
